services.name: Fishing Report
services.desc: The summer heat is in full swing in Southwest Florida, but the fishing has stayed strong. We’ve had consistent action offshore with grouper, yellowtail snapper, and red snapper keeping rods bent aboard Lucky Strike. The grouper bite continues to be reliable on our offshore spots. We can almost always count on solid catches when it comes to grouper. The real standout lately has been the yellowtail snapper bite. The yellowtail bite has been fantastic, and we’re catching some really nice-sized fish.
